reading.name: Synthesis
reading.definition: Count other Scholar-staffed Practices in this settlement whose Consume and Require inputs can currently be supplied. Each counts once; this Practice never counts itself. Empty Stock recipes qualify. Check each recipe independently through normal local, allied and neutral supply, without spending or reserving Stock. Timing and Charge readiness are not conditions. Currently counted: Irrigating, Scholarship, Papermaking. Scholar discipline. 3 counted; +3 to this Practice's Output Multiplier, capped at +4. This contribution adds to the base 1 and other multiplier sources. Base Stock yields, recipes, Research, Charge gain and capacity are unchanged.
